data.synopsis:
Wang Cheng, a prodigy soccer player, is the core of the club's attack. Amidst the praise, he becomes arrogant, leading to a loss in a crucial match. Frustrated, he and his friend Ze Yang accept the challenge from the mysterious Uncle Ai's robot team. During the match, he finally understands the value of teamwork and ultimately returns to the team to win the victory.

(Source: Douban, translated)

data.synopsis:
In the realm of Yeloli Fairyland thousands of years ago, the Golden Prince and Princess Luoli met by chance. One revered power, while the other guarded love; drawn together by destiny, gold and a sincere heart quietly converged. Yet, as Mandora’s greed and schemes closed in, gold, the lust for power, and love became intertwined in an inescapable fate. With the royal house on the brink of collapse and a storm gathering, this encounter—born of a stirring of the heart—would ultimately serve as the prologue to rewriting the destiny of Fairyland. Could they hold fast to one another amidst the peril?

(Source: Mango TV, translated)
